title: Face Sculpt #184 (일본 · 아이돌 · 귀여운 · 립 리프트 · 성형 코 2단 · V라인 · 45도 · 메이크업 없음 · P5 · 대형 귀걸이 폭포형 샹들리에 · 눈썹 대용 스파이크 스터드 · 피부톤 블루블랙 · 배경 실외 비 오는 밤 청록·남색 네온 · 렌즈 형광 라임(방사형 무늬))
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, her head turned about forty-five degrees to her right in a three-quarter view, her eyes still looking straight into the camera, one ear and the turned cheek clearly visible, and from this angle the full projection of her lips from her face is clearly visible, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the line of her shoulders, the frame cutting off just below them, so the long earrings fully hang in view. Her face is large and sharp. Early 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult woman — THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky with a soft healthy sheen, early 20s, a sleek high ponytail with wispy side bangs, vivid neon lime-green coloured contact lenses with a radiating sunburst iris pattern, both eyes the same, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, sitting naturally on the irises and clear of the eyelids, wide bright eyes, cheeks lifted by a playful half-smile with a hint of teeth, a cute, playful expression — a photograph of a real Japanese woman's face, not an illustration, not a render. She has no eyebrows at all: her brow bones are bare skin, with two or three small sharp polished silver cone-spike studs at the outer end of each brow bone, standing out from the skin, kept well away from her eyes. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living skin with visible pores and faint peach-fuzz hairs, slightly asymmetrical with a few small natural beauty marks and freckles, never airbrushed and never smooth like plastic, real wet catchlights in the eyes, individual hair strands catching the light. Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her lips are the star of her face (the shape, size and projection described here override the lips of her makeup, while the lip colour and finish follow her makeup and ignore any lip colour named here): a 'lip lift': a short, lifted space between the base of the nose and the upper lip, the upper lip curled up and outward, a high, gently smiling upper lip line with a sliver of her upper front teeth showing between softly parted lips, in glossy soft coral, youthful and fresh; her nose: a very steep, sharply sculpted surgical nose: a knife-like bridge that rises steeply and sharply from the brow, a needle-pointed tip projecting well forward, and very narrow, tightly pinched nostril wings with thin, slit-like nostrils; her jawline and chin: an extreme, razor-sharp V-line: the cheeks taper in a long, smooth, straight diagonal from the ears down to a small, narrow, pointed chin, a very slim lower face with a sharply defined sculpted jaw edge. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque.

Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about eleven in total (not counting the hanging drops), spread over every area so that no area is empty: a single large septum ring of different sizes and shapes through the thin soft wall between the nostrils, in a short stack that ends above the upper lip; one small ring wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; one straight bar across the bridge of the nose, from just below the inner ends of the brows (well clear of the eyes) down to the middle of the nose, each with a gem cap at both ends; on each ear, two separate large healed openings in the earlobe, one below the other with a clear gap of bare skin between them, the lower opening holding a gigantic multi-tier waterfall chandelier earring, a large classic round O-ring hoop in the lobe with three stacked tiers of marquise and teardrop gem drops cascading from it, each tier wider than the last, as wide as her palm and as long as her hand, hanging freely in the air down to the level of her collarbone and no lower, and the upper opening holding a large classic round hoop earring, and above them sit zero thick classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim above the lobe; one small stud across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; one small stud on each temple bone, well clear of the eyes; one small stud along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. Every piece on her face is bright and light-coloured, so that it gleams clearly against her deep skin: small polished gold and mirror-silver studs, rings and bars, and tiny clear diamonds and pearls. The left and right sides are balanced. The pieces are spread over the whole face in clear rows so every one reads individually, with bare skin between them; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. The face and ear jewelry is real polished bright yellow gold and mirror silver set with clear diamonds, white pearls and icy pale gems, every piece light and gleaming, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Hair: her hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, her jawline and her neck fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Lighting: The background is a city street at night in the rain, blurred neon signs and car lights in teal and deep blue, out of focus with a shallow depth of field, with no objects and no people in the background, and the background is darker and softer than her face so that her face and the metal are the brightest, sharpest part of the image. The background colours are cool, mid-to-dark tones clearly different from her skin tone, never beige, peach, orange or brown, and never bright. A soft key light from the front and slightly to the side on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
